arrive.text: A clinic. Very clean, very quiet, and very expensive.

pitch.text: Plug in, and you can have any life you like. Write the great novel. Fall in love. Climb the mountain. Be adored. All of it will feel completely real.

forever.text: Once you're in, you won't know it's a machine. Not ever. Not for the rest of your life.

tanks.text: People, floating, smiling a little. Somewhere, they're having the best day of their lives.

brochure.text: A brochure. Every picture in it is of someone laughing.

demo.text: For a minute, you're on a stage, and everyone is cheering. It feels completely real.

demo_2.text: And then you're back. It was wonderful. It was also nothing at all.

plug_1.text: It's perfect. Everything you ever wanted, just the way you wanted it.

plug_2.text: And you'll never know it isn't real. Does it matter, if you never know?

idle.text: You don't decide. The technician shows you out, into the rain.

home_1.text: Outside, it's raining. Your friend is waiting at the bus stop, and waves.

home_2.text: Nothing out here was made for you. But it's real, and you're really in it. Is that worth more than feeling good?

twist.text: Actually, there's something we should have told you. You've been in one of our machines all along. This is it. All of it.

air.text: The door opens onto a street you know very well. Is it really there?

unplug_1.text: You wake up, cold, in a tank, in a grey room full of tanks.

unplug_2.text: Everything you knew was made for you. This isn't. It's real. Was it worth it?

stay_1.text: You sit back down. Nothing changes. Nothing at all.

stay_idle.text: You don't pull the plug. Nothing changes.

stay_2.text: When people are told their life was a machine all along, most of them choose to keep it.
